from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from numpy import pi
qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
for j in range(3):
    qc.h(j)
    for k in range(j+1, 3):
        angle = -2 * pi / (2 ** (k - j + 1))
        qc.cp(angle, k, j)
qc.swap(0, 2)
claim: Implements inverse QFT(3) using H gates, controlled-phase gates with negative angles, and qubit swap, which reverses the standard QFT operation.

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
# Grover iteration for |10>
# Initialize to |++>
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
# Oracle: mark |10> with phase -1 (q[1]=1, q[0]=0 in Qiskit convention)
qc.x(0)
qc.cz(1, 0)
qc.x(0)
# Diffusion operator 2|s><s| - I
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)
qc.cz(0, 1)
qc.x(0)
qc.x(1)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
